capture_scope: Five exact repositories; Git branch/HEAD/tree/dirty inventory; named current authority/task/source hashes only
snapshot_limit: Inventory and hashes, not a full-byte backup, accepted candidate, or atomic freeze. Existing dirty bytes retained; concurrent changes must be re-read before acting.

source_drift.disposition: Current asset checkout differs preserved Phase1 source pin; record only. No repin/import/publication/compatibility claim.
